section.title: What is new with WSIF?
section.p: 2nd February 2003 - WSIF distribution files is now moved to its pernament home at http://ws.apache.org/dist/wsif.
WSIF has it's own home at http://ws.apache.org/wsif .
27th January 2003 - The first Apache WSIF release is now available. You can download it from http://cvs.apache.org/dist/axis/wsif/.
A list of changes in this release is available (you can also visit online list of changes in the latest CVS version to monitor WSIF progress).
